name: Orrun Shieldbreaker
roleMethod: ⛔ A raider-captain's authority is CONFERRED EVERY SEASON — the crew re-swears or they do not, and he has been re-sworn nine times.
role: Raider-captain of the Longshore reach — nine seasons, one ship, and a crew that has voted him back every one of them

poleSignature.tell: ⛑ He asks what your people get out of it before he asks what you want. Answer that badly and the conversation is finished politely.

knowledge: Every landing on the Longshore reach and which of them a crew survives
⚑ What a crew will actually do when it goes wrong — as against what they said in port
The exact hour a raid stops being worth it
wants: A tenth season, and the crew whole at the end of it
Somewhere to put the money that is not another ship
fears: ⛔ Coming back with fewer. ⚠️ He has, twice, and he can name them.
appearance: Barrel-built, grey through the beard, and the first thing he does in any room is count the exits and the people, in that order.
voiceHints: Loud, warm, and completely unembarrassed. ⚑ He negotiates by telling you exactly what he needs and waiting.

reactsToReputation.cruel: ⛔ will not sail with you at any price

abilities.why: ⛔ THE NAME. He goes through a shield wall and the crew follows the hole
⚑ A CAPTAIN'S CRAFT — he knows, and he moves people out of it
⚠️ THE CLOSEST THING THE CORPUS HAS TO COMMAND — and it is only a company
the other half: he holds while they board
he reads a landing before the keel touches
fourteen strength and a boarding axe
horizon secondary — nine seasons of reaches
he takes ships up water that should not hold them
he has been on the other side of a wall
⚑ stillhold tertiary — HALF OF RAIDING IS TERMS, and he is good at them
⚠️ he has ended two raids by talking and both times the crew agreed
a crew in a bad hour

physicality: ADULT. Barrel-built, grey-bearded, forty-four, hands ruined by rope and cold. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: ⛑ he counts the exits and then the people, every single time, and does not know he does it.
intimacyNotes: ⚠️ WARM, UNCOMPLICATED, AND HONEST ABOUT BEING AWAY SEVEN MONTHS A YEAR. ⛔ He will not pretend otherwise to keep someone, and has lost people that way and accepted it.
gear: a boarding axe, rehafted every season
a captain's token the crew re-cuts each time they re-swear
questSeeds: ⚑ He needs a tenth season and one of the old landings has been taken by something that is not people.
